sites.era: ancient (era not stated in the tariff annex)
sites.what: Archaeological monument at Chavín de Huántar, with the Museo Nacional Chavín nearby.

access.tickets: Monument: S/15 general, S/5 students, S/2 minors. Museo Nacional Chavín: S/10 general, S/5 students, S/2 minors. Free on Tuesdays for registered residents of Chavín de Huántar district. 50% concessions as for other ministry sites. (No RBA rate for PEN; at the Banco Central de Reserva del Perú rate of 30 October 2026 crossed via the RBA USD rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 2.4408 PEN: S/15 ≈ A$6.15; S/5 ≈ A$2.05; S/2 ≈ A$0.82; S/10 ≈ A$4.10)

layers.authority: SERNANP (Servicio Nacional de Areas Naturales Protegidas por el Estado)
layers.process: Huascaran National Park: the single tariff (tarifa unica) that applies to visitors who are not Peruvian residents is S/ 60 for 1 day (about A$24.58), S/ 90 for 2 to 3 days (A$36.87) and S/ 180 for 4 to 30 days (A$73.75), in tariff group I. Under-5s, people with disability and tourist guides enter free. The lower special tariff is for nationals and resident foreigners only. The head of each area can set promotional rates. A$ about: S/ 1 = A$0.41 (PEN 3.467 per USD, central-bank-rates.json 30 Oct 2026, with RBA A$1 = USD 0.7040).
